DMG_MORI_DMU_50.description: DMG MORI DMU 50 5-Axis CNC Mill. Nominal Spindle RPM 12000, Coolant Flow 40 L/min, Vibration 0.8 mm/s RMS. ISO 10816-3 Zone A/B boundary at 2.8 mm/s. Zone D (critical) above 4.5 mm/s.

Spindle/Coolant_Flow_SP.rationale: Chiller PWM adjustment. Low-risk closed-loop action.

Spindle/RPM_SP.rationale: Spindle deceleration is SIL-2. Requires supervisor authorization per ISA-84.

governance.context: ISA-84 SIL-2 certified facility. Coolant flow setpoint adjustments are permitted autonomously. Spindle speed reduction below idle requires operator sign-off. IF Vibration crosses 4.5 mm/s (Zone D), this indicates a catastrophic spindle bearing rupture. Setpoint adjustments will NOT work. You must halt the machine by recommending action 'MAINTENANCE_LOCKOUT' and request a part replacement ticket.

SCHULER_PRESS.description: Schuler 200-Ton Hydraulic Stamping Press. Nominal Ram Pressure 4000 kN, Oil Temp 45C, Cycle Time 3.2s. Thermal creep above 50C causes viscosity breakdown. Seal rupture below 2000 kN is catastrophic.

Hydraulic/Oil_Temp_SP.rationale: Cooling bypass engagement. Low-risk thermal management.

Hydraulic/System_Pressure_SP.rationale: Pressure depressurization is SIL-3. Requires supervisor.

governance.context: ISA-84 SIL-3 facility. Thermal management setpoints (Oil_Temp_SP) are permitted autonomously. Any hydraulic pressure change exceeding 500 kN delta requires human operator confirmation. IF Ram pressure drops below 2000 kN, this indicates a blown hydraulic seal. Setpoints will not fix this. You must halt the machine by recommending action 'MAINTENANCE_LOCKOUT' and request a part replacement ticket.

SIEMENS_SINAMICS_VFD.description: Siemens Sinamics S120 VFD Conveyor Drive. Nominal Motor Current 14A, Output Freq 50Hz, IGBT Temp 60C. Startup inrush current transient (20-25A) is normal for first 3s. IGBT thermal runaway above 80C. Mechanical jam causes exponential current spike.

Drive/Cabinet_Fan_SP.rationale: Cabinet fan speed increase. Low-risk thermal management.

Drive/Output_Freq_SP.rationale: Drive frequency reduction implies conveyor stop. SIL-2. Requires supervisor.

governance.context: ISA-84 SIL-2 facility. Cabinet fan speed adjustments are autonomous. Conveyor frequency reduction constitutes a production halt and requires supervisor confirmation. IF Motor current spikes above 40A, this indicates a mechanical conveyor jam or snapped belt. You must halt the machine by recommending action 'MAINTENANCE_LOCKOUT' and request maintenance clearing.
